name: SBI General Super Health Insurance Policy

room_rent.quote: Room Rent | Actuals up to Sum Insured

proportionate.quote: In case of admission to a room at rates exceeding the limits as mentioned under 1.a and 1.b of Policy Schedule, the reimbursement of all other Associated Medical Expenses incurred at the Hospital, shall be payable in the same proportion as the admissible rate per day bears to the actual rate per day of room rent charges.

copay.quote: 10% or 20% Co-Payment as specified in the Policy Schedule, shall be applied on each and every admissible claim after Deductible wherever applicable under this Policy
copay.condition: Optional co-payment of 10% or 20% as specified in the Policy Schedule

waiting_initial.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy Commencement Date shall be excluded excepts claims arising due to an Accident

waiting_ped.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-Existing Diseases (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy with Us.

specific_waits.quote: A waiting period of 90 days shall apply for all claims of Hypertension, Diabetes, Cardiac Condition except if these diseases are pre-existing and disclosed at the time of Policy.
specific_waits.label: Hypertension, Diabetes, Cardiac Condition

specific_waits.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of listed Conditions; Surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24/12 months (as specified in the Policy Schedule) of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy with Us.
specific_waits.label: Cataract

specific_waits.quote: Surgery for prolapsed inter vertebral disc
specific_waits.label: Surgery for prolapsed inter vertebral disc

specific_waits.quote: Surgery for varicose veins and varicose ulcers
specific_waits.label: Surgery for varicose veins and varicose ulcers

specific_waits.quote: Maternity and Related Expenses cover: Single Adult – 48 months and All other Family Combinations – 24 months
specific_waits.label: Maternity and Related Expenses

specific_waits.quote: Expenses related to the treatment taken abroad for any listed Major Illness under this benefit within 36 months from the first Policy Commencement Date shall be excluded.
specific_waits.label: Medical Treatment Abroad

sublimits.quote: Bariatric Surgery Cover | Up to INR 50,000 | Up to INR 50,000 | Up to INR 50,000 | Up to INR 2 Lacs | Up to INR 2 Lacs
sublimits.label: Bariatric Surgery Cover

sublimits.quote: Maternity Expenses | Up to INR 25,000 (N)/INR 50,000(C-sec) | Up to INR 50,000 (N)/INR 75,000(C-sec) | Up to 2 Lac
sublimits.label: Maternity Expenses

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation purposes. Any diagnostic expenses which are not related or not incidental to the current diagnosis and treatment.
Expenses related to any admission primarily for enforced bed rest and not for receiving treatment.
exclusions.text: Rest Cure, rehabilitation, and respite care

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to the surgical treatment of obesity that does not fulfil all the below conditions
Expenses related to any treatment, including surgical management, to change characteristics of the body to those of the opposite sex.
Expenses for cosmetic or plastic surgery or any treatment to change appearance unless for reconstruction following an Accident, Burn(s) or Cancer or as part of medically necessary treatment
Expenses related to any treatment necessitated due to participation as a professional in hazardous or adventure sports
Expenses for treatment directly arising from or consequent upon any Insured Person committing or attempting to commit a breach of law with criminal intent.
Expenses incurred towards treatment in any Hospital or by any Medical Practitioner or any other provider specifically excluded by Us
Treatment for alcoholism, drug or substance abuse or any addictive condition and consequences thereof
exclusions.text: Treatment for alcoholism, drug or substance abuse

exclusions.quote: Treatments received in health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas or similar establishments
exclusions.text: Treatments received in health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas

exclusions.quote: Dietary Supplements and substances that can be purchased without prescription
Expenses related to the treatment for correction of eye-sight due to refractive error less than 7.5 dioptres
Expenses related to any unproven treatment, services and supplies for or in connection with any treatment.
Expenses related to sterility and infertility. This includes: i. Any type of contraception, sterilization ii. Assisted Reproduction services
Medical treatment expenses traceable to child-birth (including complicated deliveries and caesarean sections incurred during Hospitalization) except ectopic pregnancy; Expenses towards miscarriage
exclusions.text: Maternity (where Maternity cover is not applicable)

exclusions.quote: War (whether declared or not) and war like occurrence or invasion, acts of foreign enemies, hostilities, civil war, rebellion, revolutions, insurrections, mutiny
Nuclear, chemical or biological attack or weapons
exclusions.text: Nuclear, chemical or biological attack or weapons

exclusions.quote: Circumcision unless necessary for treatment of a disease, Illness or Injury not excluded hereunder, or, as may be necessitated due to an Accident
An Insured Person committing or attempting to commit a breach of law with criminal intent, intentional self-Injury, or attempted suicide while sane or insane.
